_doc: Every key on which data/live_config.json and data/demo_config.json differ, with both values, since when (git blame of each file's line, the later of the two; keys renamed by lock labels phase 3 on 2026-10-31, 3b60485, are blamed under their old name at its parent), and why as far as the record says. Held to the files by tests/test_config_book_differences.py: a difference that is not listed, a listed value that changed, or a listed key the files now agree on fails. A Settings save or a Promote that changes a differing key updates this list in the same commit, with its reason. Written 2026-11-28 on Niclas's direction with R151: 'när skillnaderna är avsiktliga är det värt att skriva ner vilka de är. Då går det att skilja en avsiktlig skillnad från en som har glidit dit.' Book parity (tests/test_book_parity.py) reads rules; this reads values. Vault: raw/notes/2026-11/2026-11-28-apex-get-config-readers-money-path-scope.md.

live_account_since.why: live only: the start of the canonical live sample, the Alpaca paper account reset of 2026-07-07; demo has no broker account, and nothing in demo reads the key

l5_positioning_leading_mode.why: each file holds its book's default as written out on 2026-09-30 (config.py DEMO_L5_POSITIONING_LEADING_MODE per_ticker_p25 for demo); no ruling on record that the books should differ
